title: inventory-service outage from a misconfigured environment variable at deploy time
summary: A deployment to inventory-service shipped with an incorrect value for a feature-flag environment variable, unintentionally enabling a half-finished feature in production and causing widespread request failures.
root_cause: The deployment pipeline did not validate environment variable values against an allowed schema before rollout, so a typo'd config value reached production undetected.
fix: Added config validation as a required pre-deploy check, and staged the rollout so config changes reach a small percentage of traffic before going fully live.
